# clickup_user_groups (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (Number) Workspace ID. **Note**: For this endpoint, `team_id`` is a required query parameter.

### Optional

- `group_ids` (List of String) Enter one or more User Group IDs to retrieve information about specific User Group(s).\
 \
For example: \
 \
`?team_id=12456&group_ids=ABC12345&group_ids=DEF98765`
